# NeoGAF

> > NeoGAF is a premier video game community forum featuring discussion, membership tiers, and annual wrapped statistics for gaming enthusiasts.

NeoGAF serves as a central hub for video game discussion and community engagement, offering Gold Membership benefits and integrated features like NeoGAF Wrapped 2025 for tracking user activity. The platform leverages modern web technologies and supports community monetization through Patreon integration.

## Key Topics

- NeoGAF
- Gold Membership
- Video Gaming
- Community Forum
- Gaming Discussion
- Patreon

- User Login
- Community Features
- Membership Benefits
